pattern: proxy finish LIGHT (proxy_finish.py stage_light + proxy_finish_light.py): the frozen Pixal3D sheet proxy kept as generated (geometry + texture), made watertight, decimated, baked, optionally reposed with bones

refloor.why: sheet_proxy already floored the FEET (the crystal toe claws: z 0.00..0.05 at |x| 0.3..1.85, y -1.04..0.82; no tail / hem below them): the window only confirms the foot contact (z0 0.0) and rescales x(6.74 / 6.676) = 1.0096 to the sheet front height

dense.why: the head / face: ears, brow, glowing eyes, nose, muzzle, mouth line (proxy slabs z 5.2..6.7 after the refloor: head x -0.95..1.10 above the fur ring, y -1.77 (snout, landmark front_most z 5.47 x1.0096) ..0.35; sha 4b3d3ed2); vg_weight 0.3 so the eye boxes below can sit denser

the -x eye (proxy cyan texels x -0.127..-0.004, y -1.525..-1.443, z 5.82..6.05, centre -0.068, -1.497, 5.925) held denser so the glow lands on the eye faces, not the brow fur (vulture_creature lesson)

light.ao_why: AO baked on the watertight low itself: the proxy's fur shards / crystal plates are inner shells that black-hole AO rays (crystal_canine / vulture_creature / frost_calf lesson)
light.ao_distance_why: run 1 at 0.45 u (frost_calf value): the fur ring's shard soup took AO to median 0.62 (charcoal fur 0.40, white 0.72; p10 0.07): basecolor charcoal L* 23 / white 70 vs the sheet 33 / 81. 0.2 u (about one fur-shard length) keeps the real crevices (arm pits, between the legs, under the ring) and drops the broad darkening
light.bake_drop_interior_why: proxy faces with solid on both sides (inner fur / crystal shells) left out of the bake source so the cage stays tight and rays hit the outer skin

recolour3d.name: crystals
recolour3d.why: unit note: the crystals read dull. Proxy crystal texels (b* < -20, 6.1 % of the surface: chest, arms, legs, hand + toe claws) median 85,109,159 (L* 46, b* -27) vs the sheet crystals (front / side view b* < -20: median 112,141,213, L* 59, a* 7.5, b* -34; p10..p90 L* 39..78). Blue texels (b* <= -20, soft to -17; run 1 at -17 also turned the faintly blue-shaded flank fur (b* -14..-20, only 50 % of it within 0.06 u of a real crystal) into vivid crystal, scattering blue facets over the side view) to the sheet crystal hue with the facets kept (gamma 0.9; highlights may go to 1.6x so the lightning cores read pale cyan-white like the sheet's p90 166,199,250). Sim on the proxy samples: L* p10/50/90 40/61/81. The head (z >= 5.25) is excluded: no crystals there on the sheet, and the eyes / pale brow streaks stay as generated (face as generated)

recolour3d.name: fur
recolour3d.why: unit note: the proxy reads darker than the sheet, and it is the TEXTURE, not the panel lighting: proxy white fur (L* > 55) median 175,177,183 (L* 72) vs the sheet 194..199,200..202,203..204 (L* 78..81, p25..p75 70..83); proxy charcoal fur (L* < 40) 51,48,50 (L* 20) vs the sheet 76..77,74..76,85..88 (L* 32..33). Both furs share one cool-neutral hue on the sheet, so ONE tone curve (no white / charcoal split, so no posterised border): luma' = target x (luma / median)^0.743, the exponent fitted so proxy charcoal luma 49 -> 77 and white 177 -> 200 (+~7 % for the AO multiply; run 1 target 130,132,141 left the baked albedo white fur at L* p75 82 but basecolor median 70); highlights capped at 1.65x. Sim on the proxy samples: white L* p25/50/75 76/83/87, charcoal L* 31/34/39 (sheet 70/81/83, 33). Selects b* >= -16 (soft to -19), meeting the crystal pass; the crystal texels (now b* < -30) are not selected; the cyan eyes (b* -29..-39) keep their colour

glow3d.name: eyes
glow3d.why: sheet: GLOWING BLUE EYES: faces of the proxy's cyan eye texels (boxes = the texel extents + 0.02 u, after the x1.0096 rescale) whose baked albedo is blue (b* < -15; the white brow fur is b* -6) -> region eye_glow (emission = the sheet eye core, brightest quarter 119..144,163..188,231..240)

glow3d.name: crystal_core
glow3d.why: sheet: 'lightning contained within crystals', the internal glow, no external arcs: the brightest crystal faces (baked L* >= 70 and b* <= -24, the top quarter of the recoloured crystals: the lightning cores) -> crystal_core (emission = the sheet's 6th chip, the bright cyan 46,193,253, not auto-found by intake; sampled at chip px 1611,868)

glow3d.name: crystal_body
glow3d.why: the rest of the crystal faces (chest, arms, legs, hand + toe claws: baked b* <= -24, so only clearly blue crystal faces emit, not the blended crystal / fur border faces) -> crystal_glow (emission = the sheet's deep crystal chip 61,106,244, low scale: a translucent inner glow, the faceted albedo still reads)

light.ao_fill_why: run 1: 10 % of the AO texels under 0.07 (bake origins inside the fur soup, the dark blotches on the face in the head close-up): texels under 0.04 refilled from valid neighbours (vulture_creature / sand_drill_worm idiom)
light.uv_island_margin_why: run 2: the fur-shard low unwraps into ~3970 islands; at the default margin the atlas held 10.2 % texels (check uv_health coverage 0.102), the albedo blurred into blotches: margin 0.001 (vulture_creature idiom)

belly.why: artist 2026-10-17: 'can we make storm bear fatter, bigger belly' (orchestrator: ~15-20 % more belly depth in the side view and width in the front view, most at the navel). Navel cz 2.8 = the middle of the belly dip on the low (belly front y -0.61 at z 2.5..3.1 vs -0.80 at the chest z 3.3 and the crotch z 2.3); cy 0.55 = the spine line. At cz: torso width 2.00 u (front view, arms / legs excluded) and depth 2.24 u (side view, belly front to the back of the coat, |x| < 0.6): push_front 0.38 = +17 % depth, push_side 0.17 per side = +17 % width; z_radius 0.75 below / 0.80 above so the push fades out by the crotch (2.05) and under the chest V tip (3.6); front_x_radius 1.6 rounds the belly; the coat behind y 1.2 is not widened. The legs keep their shape (exclude); the arms swing out rigidly about the shoulder by atan(0.17 / 1.65) = 5.9 deg so the gap to the fuller belly stays. light.pulls does not fit: it runs on the proxy BEFORE the watertight remesh, so a belly pushed toward the arms (0.1..0.2 u gap) would fuse with them, and its constant grab vector cannot carry the arms rigidly

chains.name: arm
chains.why: v2 (measured on the v1 low, arm slabs |x| > 1.15): points = the +x arm, points_R = the -x arm as generated: shoulder (inside the fur ring, z 4.45; the -x shoulder sits 0.2 u forward), elbow (z 3.4: +x 1.62, 0.10 / -x -1.67, -0.36), wrist (z 2.5: 1.62, -0.52 / -1.61, -0.92), claw centre (z 1.76: 1.56, -0.84 / -1.57, -1.14): the -x arm hangs 0.30..0.46 u further forward; the repose makes the pair symmetric

chains.name: leg
chains.why: v2 (leg slabs 0.2 < |x| < 1.6): points = the +x leg, points_R = the -x leg: hip (inside the pelvis), knee (z 1.05: 0.95, 0.50 / -0.99, 0.29), ankle (z 0.42: 1.10, 0.38 / -1.20, 0.22), toe (front claws, z 0.08: foot front y -0.85 / -1.06): the -x leg is staggered 0.19..0.23 u forward

chains.name: mantle
chains.why: v2: the dark fur COAT down the back (sheet: 'extends down back'; the back view draws it on the midline). As generated its lower half hangs to -x: the deep-back centroid (y in the back 30 %) is x -0.25..-0.32 at z 1.5..2.4, -0.16 at 3.0, ~0 at 4.2. A chain so it rests centred (repose to_points) and can be posed; kind 'chain' (a small sway in the clips)

rig.spine_why: v2: the spine on the body midline x 0 (low slab mid-x z 2.0..5.0: -0.08..+0.06); neck root (0, 0.1, 5.05); the head bone runs from the pivot (0.01, -0.4, 5.6; between the ears, ear centroids x +0.424 / -0.390 at y -0.49) to the snout (0.125, -1.7, 5.65; snout mid-x +0.117 at y < -1.3, z 5.5..5.8), so its heading IS the face's turn (5.1 deg to +x)

clips.why: PLACEHOLDER (movement + height are the open artist questions, OPEN-QUESTIONS storm_bear): idle = breathe + the kit's arm sway; walk = a heavy upright bear stride with a small arm swing (frost_giant values); leg_swing 8 (run 2 at 12: the kit's foot bend dipped the toes 0.43 u below the floor in walk, clip_loops min_z -0.433)

config._doc: v2 (2026-10-17): LIGHT finish of the raw Pixal3D proxy (seed 56, sha 4b3d3ed2) + bone repose to a symmetric rest pose (arms, legs, head, coat) + light.belly. Points: stage-1 frame (feet already on the floor, x1.0096 to the sheet front height), sheet units.

targets.why: artist 2026-10-17: a symmetric rest pose; the two arms mirror-symmetric at the mean (the -x arm hung 0.30..0.46 u forward). No plant: the hands hang free
targets.radius_why: [reach, taper] per bone: arm / leg bones never grab the torso sides (the arm inner edge is only 0.1..0.2 u from the belly)

targets.why: the two legs mirror-symmetric at the mean (the -x leg staggered ~0.2 u forward), both feet planted on the floor
targets.radius_why: [reach, taper] per bone: arm / leg bones never grab the torso sides (the arm inner edge is only 0.1..0.2 u from the belly)

targets.heading: -y
targets.why: the head turned ~5 deg to +x (snout mid-x +0.117): the face straight ahead (-y); the neck twists half, the head the rest
the coat on the midline: its chain carried onto x = 0 at the same heights / depths (the coat keeps its drape and length)

rigid.why: the head / face moves as ONE rigid body with the head bone: never deformed or re-sculpted (face as generated)

units: sheet units: 1 unit = 100 px of the reference sheet; floor z = 0

high.rule: marching tets of the whole remesh grid (no mirror)

low.method: collapse decimation: uniform to 300000, then 18000 with the dense boxes calibrated

dense.rule: dense boxes weighted 0.02 (vs 1) in the collapse decimation; the factor bisected until the boxes hold density x the rest's triangles per area

ao_fill.rule: AO < below = a bake origin inside the proxy soup: refilled from the covered valid 3x3 neighbours ring by ring (opt-in light.ao_fill_below)

bake.source: the proxy mesh itself (not the remesh)

repose.rule: LBS with the contract rig's weights (+ rigid pins), yaw-only straightening (+ lift), applied as rest

stretch_mantle.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

self_intersections.rule: intersecting triangle pairs sharing no vertex (BVH overlap)

mirror_before.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

mirror_after.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)
